description: Living Graph overlay pack for the shipped coderef-map viewer: port the useful parts of the Entity code-city experiment (graph style, not city blocks) as data-grounded canvas layers — animated BFS blast pulse, lens presets (Risk/Structure/Hygiene/History), weight-tiered highway edges with flow particles and edge-evidence click-through, labeled community hulls with drift-outlier marks. Phase-1 items need zero engine changes (MapData v1.4 already ships the data); the decay lens rides the existing opt-in git-behavioral block; every layer encodes measured surfaces, never verdicts. Ref: Entity apps/web/app/coderef/city + coderef/working/code-city-living-system/ROADMAP.md.
